Ipse magnus Astronomus & jejunator. Per se-

ter quàm veneno tolli posset, relicto successore,

page.notes: Left page is cut off at its right edge; only fragments of its lines are visible and are not transcribed. Marginal note "Elmacin. Hist. p. 32." is partly obscured. Several words are blurred and uncertain. Left margin strip is cut off; only fragments of notes are visible (e.g. "Palæ", "edes", "Oc-", "arha-", "Bal-"), too incomplete to transcribe reliably.
